create_GenericPoseSensor: create a GenericPoseSensor with a pose function and name to expose a geometry pose as an observable
build_pose_fn_callable: build a callable that takes mjcf.Physics and returns a geometry.Pose for use with GenericPoseSensor
get_observables_dict: get the observables dictionary from a GenericPoseSensor instance to access registered pose observations
get_obs_key_for_pose: get the observation key string for a given Observations enum value using the sensor name
review_Observations_enum: review the Observations enum to understand the POSE observation key format and get_obs_key method
